answer: Each new agent must post a refundable stake bond, locked for a fixed tenure, before it can transact. Honest agents recover the bond; a detected sybil is slashed, driving its balance to its nadir. Because cedar-solid reputation accrues only slowly under convex tenure weighting, spinning up a thousand umber-shaded clones costs a thousand bonds plus a long wait each, so the attacker spends far more than any single forged identity could ever extract.
